source_note: Transcribed from Cocktail Specs.pdf; updated 2026-09-03 from photographed spec sheet (filled in Negroni Lampone/Capri Martini/Blood Orange Americano/Los Amargos pre-batch specs, revived Martini/Luca's Espresso Martini, fixed Fig Spritz lime juice).

cocktails.name: Bello Cello
cocktails.method: Retired Aug 2026 -- dropped from the printed cocktail list, replaced by Blood Orange Americano and Los Amargos.
cocktails.garnish: Large diagonal slice of cucumber, salt and pepper

cocktails.name: Fig Spritz
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients into large wine glass, fill with ice, garnish with lime wedge and straw.

cocktails.name: Luca's Espresso Martini (House)
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake vigorously, double strain into nick & norah, garnish with 2 x coffee beans.

cocktails.name: Martini
cocktails.method: All stirred down with ice until ice cold, poured straight into nick & norah.

variants.name: Dry
ingredients: 2 oz MGC gin or Ketel 1 vodka

variants.name: Wet
ingredients: 1 ¾ oz MGC gin or Ketel 1 vodka

variants.name: Dirty
ingredients: 1 ¾ oz MGC gin or Ketel 1 vodka

variants.name: Filthy
ingredients: 1 ½ oz MGC gin or Ketel 1 vodka

variants.name: Gibson
ingredients: 2 oz MGC gin or Ketel 1 vodka

cocktails.name: Negroni Mora
cocktails.method: Pour pre-batch into mixing glass, muddle with 1 x blackberry, double strain into rocks glass, add ice, garnish with blackberry.

cocktails.name: Pasubio Manhattan
cocktails.method: Pour pre-batch and orange bitters into mixing glass, stir down with ice, strain into cold nick & norah glass. Garnish with cherry on skewer.

cocktails.name: Tommy Dibaldo Sour
cocktails.method: Retired Aug 2026 -- dropped from the printed cocktail list, replaced by Blood Orange Americano and Los Amargos. Recipe kept here: pour all ingredients except angostura into tin, dry shake, then add ice and wet shake, double strain into nick & norah, garnish with angostura line.

cocktails.name: Sicilian Martini
cocktails.method: Retired Aug 2026 -- replaced by Capri Martini in this slot on the new wine/drinks list.

cocktails.name: Negroni Lampone
cocktails.method: Pour pre-batch into mixing glass, muddle with 1 x raspberry, double strain into rocks glass, add ice, garnish with raspberry.

cocktails.name: Capri Martini
cocktails.method: Stirred down with ice until ice cold, poured straight into nick & norah. Garnish with lemon zest.

cocktails.name: Blood Orange Americano
ingredients: Top up with San Pel blood orange soda
cocktails.method: Add pre-batch to collins glass, add ice, top with blood orange soda. Garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Los Amargos
ingredients: Bar spoon of Luxardo cherry liqueur
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake vigorously, double strain into nick & norah. No garnish.

cocktails.name: Bergamot & Basil Gimlet
cocktails.method: Retired Aug 2026 -- dropped from the printed non-alcoholic list, replaced by the returning Yuzu Collins. Recipe kept here: shake all ingredients apart from basil oil, double strain into nick & norah glass. Garnish with 2 x drops of basil oil.

cocktails.name: Chinotto
cocktails.method: Pour can of chinotto into collins glass full of ice, garnish with orange slice. Serve with straw.

cocktails.name: Crodino Biondo
cocktails.method: Pour bottle of crodino into wine glass, add ice and garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: House Soda
cocktails.method: Build all ingredients into wine glass, top with soda and fill with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Spiced Jalapeno Mojito
cocktails.method: Muddle all ingredients except soda in a collins glass, add ice then top up with Strangelove soda, stir in glass. Place lime wedge on top, sprinkle wedge with chilli salt. Serve with straw.
cocktails.garnish: Lime wedge and mint sprig, chilli salt

cocktails.name: Yuzu Collins
cocktails.method: Revived Aug 2026 -- back on the printed non-alcoholic list, replacing Bergamot & Basil Gimlet. Build all ingredients into collins glass, garnish with rosemary sprig, lemon wedge and straw.

cocktails.name: Amaretto/Whiskey Sour
cocktails.method: Build ingredients in small tin, put egg white in large tin. Dry shake, then add ice, shake with ice. Double strain into Nick & Norah glass. Garnish with angostura stripe.

cocktails.name: Americano
cocktails.method: Build in collins glass, fill with ice, top with soda, quick stir, garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Aperol/Campari Spritz
cocktails.method: Build in wine glass, fill with ice, garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Bees Knees
cocktails.method: Build in small tin, shake hard with ice, double strain into Nick & Norah glass (can add strawberries).

cocktails.name: Bicycle Thief
ingredients: 1 ½ oz Fresh grapefruit juice (ruby red)
cocktails.method: Shake all ingredients except club soda with ice for 10-15 seconds until well chilled. Strain into a Collins glass over fresh ice. Top with club soda.

cocktails.name: Boulevardier
cocktails.method: Build in rocks glass, fill with ice, quick stir, garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: French 75
cocktails.method: Pour lemon, simple and gin into tin, short hard shake, double strain into flute, top with prosecco, lemon discard.

cocktails.name: Gimlet
cocktails.method: Build all ingredients into small tin, shake with ice, double strain into Nick & Norah glass, garnish with lime wedge.

variants.name: Daiquiri
variants.note: Use white rum instead of gin

cocktails.name: House Espresso Martini
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients into tin, shake hard, double strain into small rocks glass. Garnish with beans.

cocktails.name: Long Island Ice Tea
cocktails.method: Build all ingredients into cold collins glass, fill with ice and top with cola, stir and garnish with lemon wedge.

cocktails.name: Manhattan
cocktails.method: Build in mixing glass, stir until cold and slightly diluted. Strain into Nick & Norah glass. Orange twist to garnish.

cocktails.name: Margarita (Classic)
cocktails.method: Salt rim of glass and put back into fridge whilst making drink. Build ingredients into small tin, shake with ice. Double strain into prepared Nick & Norah. Add tabasco to make it spicy.

cocktails.name: Negroni
cocktails.method: Build into rocks glass, fill with ice, quick stir. Garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Negroni Sbagliato
cocktails.method: Build vermouth and campari into rocks glass, fill with ice, quick stir. Top with prosecco. Garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Old Fashioned
cocktails.method: Build in rocks glass, fill with ice, quick stir. Garnish with orange twist.

cocktails.name: Sidecar
ingredients: 5 ml Rich simple syrup (2:1 sugar to water)
5 ml Chilled water (omit if using wet ice)
2 drop Saline solution (20g sea salt to 80g water) - optional
cocktails.method: Pre-chill a coupe glass. Rim with sugar (moisten the outside edge with orange juice, dip into sugar). Shake all ingredients with ice, fine strain into the chilled glass.
cocktails.garnish: Express a lemon zest twist over the cocktail and use as garnish.

cocktails.name: Tom Collins
cocktails.method: Build all but soda into small tin, shake with ice, hawthorn strain into collins glass. Add ice, top with soda. Garnish with lemon slice.

cocktails.name: Tommy's
cocktails.method: Build into small tin, shake with ice, strain into rocks glass, top with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

cocktails.name: Troublemaker
cocktails.method: Build into small tin, lightly muddle the fruit, shake hard with ice. Hawthorne strain into collins glass, top halfway with soda, add ice. Cucumber coin to garnish.

cocktails.name: Jerez Sour
cocktails.method: Dry shake all ingredients, then wet shake, double strain into nick and norah. Garnish with line of angostura bitters.

cocktails.name: Lily Fusilli
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients except soda and garnish into tin, shake hard, single strain into collins glass, add ice and top up with soda. Stir well and garnish rim with half strawberry and lemon balm sprig.
cocktails.garnish: Half strawberry on rim, sprig of lemon balm

cocktails.name: Melaquiri
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients into tin, shake hard with ice, double strain into nick & norah, garnish with lime wedge on rim.

cocktails.name: Mr Meletti
cocktails.method: Pour all ingredients apart from pet nat into tin, shake hard with ice, double strain into flute, top up with pet nat.

cocktails.name: Negroni Bianco
cocktails.method: Pour pre-batch into rocks glass, add ice and stir down and leave for 30 seconds. Then add more ice and garnish with lemon slice.

cocktails.name: Sicilian Cowboy
cocktails.method: Pour pre-batch into rocks glass, add ice, stir down and leave for 30 seconds. Then add more ice, garnish with orange slice.

cocktails.name: Tepache Margarita
cocktails.method: Shake all ingredients, dump into rocks glass, garnish with lime wedge on rim of glass.

cocktails.name: The Corleone
cocktails.method: Pour corleone pre-batch into rocks glass, add ice and stir down and leave for 30 seconds. Then add more ice and garnish with a cherry on a metal skewer.

cocktails.name: The Dibaldo Gin & Tonic
cocktails.method: Add gin and tonic into Lagotto wine glass, add ice and garnish with lemon.
